authors.description: Author slugs, names or numeric IDs, combined with OR. Examples: cap-joanna, Joanna Glasner.
authors.title: Authors

categories.description: Category slugs, names or numeric IDs, combined with OR. Examples: venture, startups, ai, ma, ipo, data (Funding reports). Friendly aliases such as artificial-intelligence and fintech are accepted.
categories.title: Categories

includeContent.description: Include the full article body in the content field. Turn off for a smaller, faster dataset that still includes title, excerpt, authors, taxonomy, media and funding hints.
includeContent.title: Include full article text

maxItems.description: Maximum number of articles to return. The Crunchbase News archive currently holds about 8,800 articles.
maxItems.title: Maximum articles

mode.description: Choose what to collect. Latest news, a keyword search, the Funding reports section, or a specific category, tag, author or article list.
mode.title: Mode

orderBy.description: Order of returned articles. Relevance is only available when a search keyword is set.
orderBy.title: Sort by

publishedAfter.description: Only articles published on or after this date. Use YYYY-MM-DD or a full ISO 8601 timestamp. Leave empty for no lower bound.
publishedAfter.title: Published after

publishedBefore.description: Only articles published on or before this date. Use YYYY-MM-DD or a full ISO 8601 timestamp. Leave empty for no upper bound.
publishedBefore.title: Published before

search.description: Free-text keyword matched against article titles and body text. Required in Keyword search mode; optional as an extra filter in the other list modes.
search.title: Search keyword

tags.description: Tag slugs, names or numeric IDs, combined with OR. Examples: unicorn, funding, seed-funding, venture-funding.
tags.title: Tags

urls.description: Used by the By article URLs or IDs mode. Paste full news.crunchbase.com article URLs, numeric article IDs (as text) or slugs.
urls.title: Article URLs, IDs or slugs
